layout_independence: The archived placements differ in room, furniture poses and seed and are not a controlled occlusion contrast. Freeze this development bank before observing new witness outcomes. Freeze independent matched parent rooms and the development-informed method separately before any confirmation; formal shelf settings and runs are outside this follow-up.

witness_bank.geometry_rule: Keep the native route. Within each of the two shortest strictly higher exact outbound action cost tiers, pick the pair with maximum Jaccard distance of sets of outbound grid positions and headings over the first 16 charged actions, excluding the shared initial pose. Resolve ties by the lexicographically smallest ordered pair of outbound SHA-256 identifiers. Read only cost, state, admission and route identity for this bank. Then add distinct actual D, D+ and S nominations from the published bank for measured regret. Retain the independent geometric subset separately.
witness_bank.guard: Every witness uses the exact same original simulated observations before the fork, oriented macro target, native guarded movement and original return certificate. Stop at the first actual arrival, guard cancellation, collision or terminal, as provided by the archived witness actor. Neither a safety waiver nor a return run is part of this diagnostic.

measurement: Measure fixed independent shelf reference support in actual TSDF fusion with 5 cm point-to-triangle distance. Report net new area, newly matched area and old support lost relative to the shared measured fork. Also record cabinet area, observed free coverage, scene F1, path, planned versus executed actions and exact guard status.
missingness: For each equal-clock comparison report planned routes, measured routes, guard cancellations before clock, other native stops before clock and technical failures. Mark a pre-clock stop as missing area or regret. Report the exact outbound event separately, with no equal-clock regret at unequal event clocks. Never substitute endpoints for an unobserved fixed clock.
regret: At each common clock use the measured best of the frozen union minus the measured selected route for D, D+ and S. Also report best among the score-independent geometric routes and the signed selected difference. Report whether each candidate denominator is completely observed. No unexecuted native candidate counts as a measured optimum.
reuse: Published nominations are replayed only to obtain missing frozen checkpoints, with exact matches required for the full archived sensor and motion trace, fork, original measured common checkpoint when present, native guard and terminal mesh. No reuse counts as an independent second run.
